Protocol Launching 2026

The Objective

Stables is an independent digital currency project built on Minima, a secure global network designed to give people full control over their money.

Our goal is to create a digital dollar that remains Stables and reliable, regardless of market conditions. We prioritize security and long-term resilience over speed or speculation.

The Vision

Imagine a financial system where you truly own your assets. In Stables, the rules are open, unchangeable, and apply to everyone equally.

No central authority can freeze your funds or change the rules behind closed doors. The system is owned and operated by its users.

Foundational Principles

Security before growth: Correctness and resilience always precede adoption.
No automatic progression: Every stage is conditional and explicitly validated.
Code over discretion: Protocol behavior is enforced by logic, not committees.
Transparency by default: All reasoning and planning is open for review.

Implementation Path

PHASE 1Proof of Use Concept (Working but isolated)
PHASE 2Public Testing (Adversarial with caps)
PHASE 4Security Audit (Independent scarcity)
PHASE 7Protocol Resilience (Long-term robustness)
